subject: Staged demo: calendar overlap + Meet blocked — propose delegated host and Zoom backup
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Anna Porter <anna.porter@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 May 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Staged demo: Fri 16th 10am PT — calendar conflict and Join link concerns

Hi Anna,

Thanks for the time today — we’re excited to run a focused demo next Friday (May 16). I just created a calendar invite for 10:00–11:00 PT and attached a short agenda and the integration checklist (attached).

Two quick items before we lock:
- We’ve seen a few customers where GSuite guest restrictions block the Meet join button when the organizer is external/forwarded. Could you confirm your side can access Google Meet invites from external organizers?
- If that’s likely to be an issue, would you prefer we run on Zoom instead? We can reissue an ICS from a Zoom host so the join link is stable for all attendees.

If meeting host privileges are needed on your side (for SSO or breakout setup), we can also delegate host rights or have one of our sales engineers (Ben) be the organizer and add your list.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm whether Meet works for Acme attendees (yes/no)
2) If no, I’ll ask Ben to recreate the invite with Zoom and reissue the ICS
3) I’ll share the agenda and a short run-of-show (attached)

Attaching: redwood-staged-demo-agenda.pdf, acme-demo-reqs.xlsx

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119
www.redwood.ai

From: Anna Porter <anna.porter@acmecloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: sales_ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Staged demo: Fri 16th 10am PT — calendar conflict and Join link concerns

Hi Naomi — thanks for the invite and the agenda. Quick update from our side: our org policy blocks external Meet organizers from embedding the join button for some guest domains (we're on a locked GSuite configuration for SSO).

The calendar event arrived, but several people reported the Meet join button is missing and the ICS shows a generic net.ics token that our calendar strips. I flagged with our sales ops (cc’d) but wanted to check what the easiest patch is.

Zoom would be simpler for us — if you can reissue a Zoom-based invite with a visible join link that will avoid last-minute attendee confusion. Also please include a dial-in option for APAC participants (we’ll have one attendee in Singapore).

Appreciate it,
Anna
Product Ops | Acme Cloud
anna.porter@acmecloud.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Staged demo: Fri 16th 10am PT — please recreate as Zoom and take organizer rights

Ben/Sean — forwarding Anna’s note. Acme’s org strips Meet join buttons for external organizers. Can one of you recreate the invite from a Zoom host account and include a PST/ET/APAC dial-in option? Key asks:
- Make Ben the organizer (or Sean if Ben is out), add Anna and sales_ops as required attendees
- Use a stable Zoom Meeting (no one-off quick meetings that can be dropped) and attach the agenda
- Add a short run-of-show in the event body and link to the HubSpot deal (below)

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME-98765

Also include a note in the calendar description: "If you cannot see a join button, open this Zoom link or dial +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX (code: 123456)."

Thanks — Naomi

Zoom details: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210

I also reissued the ICS from my calendar — Naomi, Sean: please confirm it landed for you and that the join button appears on your side. Anna: can you confirm your team sees the Zoom link and dial-in?

Thanks — Ben
